from prep academies and blogs. Official cutoff statistics for Korea’s civil service exams are only published after the exam by the Ministry of Personnel Management, so baking an unsupported number into this calculator and presenting it as a “prediction” could give false confidence.
Instead, this tool doesn’t supply any cutoff numbers itself. Enter
(from official government announcements), and it compares your expected score against the average, highest, and lowest of what you entered.
Cutoffs vary a lot year to year depending on exam difficulty, number of applicants, and hiring quotas. A simple comparison to past data doesn’t guarantee a future outcome.
